description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing a collection sheet for join liability groups (JLG) in the Fineract application. It encapsulates data such as due date, loan products, savings products, groups, attendance options, and payment types used for reporting or processing within the system.

classes.name: JLGCollectionSheetData
classes.description: Immutable data object for join liability group's collection sheet, containing various financial and grouping data relevant to the collection process.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a JLGCollectionSheetData instance with given date, loan products, groups, attendance options, and payment types.

methods.name: withSavingsProducts
methods.description: Static method to create a new JLGCollectionSheetData instance including savings products, based on an existing data object.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the due date associated with the collection sheet.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the collection of group data involved in the collection sheet.

methods.name: getLoanProducts
methods.description: Returns the collection of loan product data associated with the collection sheet.
